accounts.title: Calendar accounts

actions.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this calendar account? Its events leave Agenda. Nothing changes in Google or Outlook.

calendars.noneWritable: None of the switched-on calendars accepts new events.
calendars.saveError: Could not save the calendar choice.

access.title: Access
access.hint: New calendars are yours: you manage them and agents may read them. Owners and admins always manage.

agenda.noWritable: None of your calendars accepts new events. Switch one on under Connections.
